# Audio destination glyph

`device-airpods.svg` comes from [Tabler Icons](https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/blob/main/icons/outline/device-airpods.svg), under its included MIT licence. The application adapts its geometry to a 1.65-unit outline in `apple_audio_glyphs.dart` and shares it between the toolbar and device card. The icon represents headphones; native metadata retains the actual device name.

Apple's [SF Symbols](https://developer.apple.com/sf-symbols/) and playback-destination vocabulary were consulted as the requested visual reference. No Apple SF font or extracted Apple product symbol is bundled in this Android application.
